posts.text:
A successful Ukrainian operation against two Russian military targets near the Libyan port of Benghazi:

The Russian corvette Merkury was destroyed, and the sanctioned Russian cargo ship MV Angara was struck by Ukraine's Defense Forces and Security Service.

MV Angara was used to transport Russian military equipment and support military logistics, including through the so-called "Syrian Express" and "Libyan Express" routes.

The Project 20380 multipurpose corvette Merkury regularly escorted Russian naval convoys, including MV Angara. Commissioned in 2023, it belonged to Russia's Black Sea Fleet. A Ka-27 helicopter aboard the corvette also went down with the ship.

The operation involved seven Ukrainian-made naval drones, transported to the area and launched from a mothership. Despite Russian attempts to destroy them from the air, sea, and land, the drones successfully located and struck both targets.

Glory!

A second Islamic regime-aligned television company faces closure in Britain after authorities took action against HispanTV, a Spanish-language broadcaster owned by Iran's state-run Islamic Republic of Iran Broadcasting (IRIB).

British Conservative MP Alicia Kearns previously reported HispanTV and its director, Seyedmehdi Mirtaleb, 48, to the Metropolitan Police over violations of Britain's Foreign Influence Registration Scheme under the National Security Act.

Mirtaleb previously worked as an executive producer for Iran's Press TV in London, whose broadcasting license was revoked by Ofcom in 2012.

The Anti-Defamation League has accused HispanTV of spreading antisemitism and anti-Israel incitement across Latin America, describing it as the Iranian regime's “long arm of hate.”

The development follows the November 10 dissolution of Al Masirah TV's UK company, linked to Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis, after a separate investigation into its London registration.

Monday - November S&P Global Services and Manufacturing PMI data

A short week, with most of the big data landing on Wednesday.

Which will move crypto more this week: PCE inflation or Q3 GDP? 👀

Bitcoin isn’t trading like a 21M hard cap anymore. Leverage, options, and ETFs have turned it into a synthetic paper market where the supply feels practically infinite.

Exchanges and cartels are using algos + data to wipe out retail for billions every single week.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky on an operation off the coast of Libya:

The Russian corvette Merkury was sunk. It is one of Russia's newest ships, commissioned in 2023 during the full-scale war. A Ka-27 combat helicopter was destroyed along with it.

Seven Ukrainian-made naval drones were deployed. Russian forces tried to counter the attack and failed.

The Russian dry cargo vessel MV Angara, used by Russia to transport weapons, was the second target. It was hit.

Zelensky received detailed briefings on the operation over two days and confirmed all set targets were achieved. He thanked the Security Service of Ukraine and the Defense Forces of Ukraine who took part, calling it an exemplary response to Russia's war.

Ukrainian operations will continue in designated waters as Kyiv keeps developing its own weapons.
